name: JV_INVOICING_PARTNERS_B_
description: This table contains the associated customer and supplier information for invoicing partners.

columns.name: INVOICING_PARTNER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the invoicing partner.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INVOICING_PARTNER_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The short name of the invoicing partner. This value must be unique.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Unique ID of the business unit associated with the invoicing partner.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NUMBER
columns.description: The customer account number used for creating accounts receivables invoices for the partner.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_ID
columns.description: The customer site used for creating accounts receivables invoices for the partner.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_NUMBER
columns.description: The supplier account number used for creating accounts payables invoices for the partner.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.description: The supplier site used for creating accounts payables invoices for the partner.

columns.name: INVOICING_PARTNER_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the invoicing partner. Possible statuses defined in the JV INVOICING PARTNER STATUS lookup may include ACTIVE,INACTIVE, etc.

columns.name: JIB_TEMPLATE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the Joint Interest Billing report template that will default on stakeholders using this invoicing partner.

columns.name: JIB_REPORT_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: The format of the Joint Interest Billing report output that will default on stakeholders using this invoicing partner. It's based on ORA_JV_JIB_OUTPUT_FORMAT lookup codes such as ORA_JV_HTML, ORA_JV_PDF, ORA_JV_RTF, and so on.

columns.name: PARTNER_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code used to create joint venture invoices for the partner.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
